facts.fact: UNDP Malawi says the Independent Complaints Commission launched on 4 June 2025 a new Online Citizen Engagement Platform where citizens can file complaints about police misconduct, follow cases and receive updates; no case numbers are given.

MWI.note: The platform's case management system serves the police complaints commission, not courts.
The online platform takes public complaints about police misconduct; it is not a station record of reports or cases.
